description: Shared base tag contract fields for all Efficio components.

efficio_component_id.description: Stable, human-readable identifier for the component within a slide.

efficio_component_type.description: The component type for this shape. Each component contract refines this with a single-value enum.

efficio_content_role.description: Optional semantic role hint describing what this component represents on the slide.

efficio_prompt_instruction.description: Optional author guidance used when generating content for this component.
